Independent execution from a disposable candidate copy passes reader doctor and prepares a new Chapter 1 study copy. The known faulty starter remains exactly 7 cases: 3 pass, 2 failures, 2 errors. Its source, acceptance oracle and integrity checks retain their original hashes.

Live canonical guide and manifest files still match the frozen candidate record after review. The candidate record remains immutable with its original awaiting-review label; this separate decision supplies the later review result.
